reviews.x: I have medication-induced dry mouth and was beginning to wonder if I would find anything that works.  The sprays available in pharmacies were basically useless -  they don't last a half hour.  These lozenges work and they taste good.  There are times when I wake up at night as dry as a desert  I keep a few unwrapped by my bed and they work quickly.  I wish they came in a larger package.

reviews.t: Better than anything I've tried, and I've tried them all!
reviews.x: These lozenges are amazing! Not only do they taste great, but they really do moisten my mouth.  I take a lot of medications that cause a terrible dry mouth. I've tried everything for moisturizing your mouth. None of them compare to the Cotton Mouth lozenges.  They last so much longer than anything else.  Buy these if you've got a dry mouth.  You won't be disappointed!

My mom really liked these. She took medication that caused her to have a dry mouth. These, along with the sugar-free Zollipops, were very helpful in alleviating the dryness and preventing blocked salivary glands.

About 8 months ago I was diagnosed with Burning Mouth Syndrome (Yes, there is such a thing, Google it), after a year of going to various Dr's for a diagnosis, an Oral Pain Dr diagnosed it, after asking me 3 questions. One of the symptoms is dry mouth. I also have an internal pain pump, which also has side effects of dry mouth. The stores all seem to carry the same brands, Biotene & ACT, so when I saw these, I was excited to find something besides mint or lemon flavors, since I basically use them
My husband uses a C-Pap and without these his mouth dries out at night. The lozenges help a lot.

I stumbled upon these while looking for another specific brand.  Turns out they were sold out so I ordered these, a bit skeptical but the brand made me laugh so....  these provide such relief & are really good tasting.  The lozenge lasts for about 10 minutes & the relief lasts for a long time.  Highly recommended.  BTW I don't even look for the "other" brand now.  Hooked on Cotton Mouth!

I have used it a few years. It helps with dry mouth at night. However I open each individual lozenge and put in a bedside bowl because it would be impossible to open one in the middle of the night when I need it. I know it is p[ackaged that way so they do not stick together.
I use these for my Sjogrens, the flavors are good they last for a while. Used to buy them from Walmart but they don’t have them in the store. Thank god Amazon carries them.
They do the job to stop the dry mouth. I woul recommend it to anyone. And the price is good too!

reviews.t: Really helps with cpap dry mouth.
reviews.x: I tried this product to help with dry mouth and throat from using a cpap. The lozenges work well and are long lasting. The flavor is mild and not over powering. I simply place one on one side of my cheek like using dip. I can sleep several hours and awaken with my mouth and throat with much more moisture than using the cpap alone. If you have dry mouth from using a cpap, I recommend trying them. I’m glad to have found them!

Great price, mostly because sorbitol is used, not xylitol which is apparently more expensive. Happily, sorbitol seems to be much less toxic to dogs than xylitol, so I feel better about having these lozenges around. The downside is the flavors. The apple, lemon and orange are OK. The grape is off-putting and there's a ton of them :(

reviews.t: These work very well for my dry mouth
reviews.x: I have chronic dry mouth and these work very well for it and don't have a lot of ingredients that I'm sensitive to. Nothing works for a long time but these help for sure.
These little lozenges are great for the horrible taste that Covid leaves in your mouth but getting them open from the wrap is a challenge. Takes patience!
These are pretty good, last a sufficient time, but there seems to be a lot of dark colored lozenges. Having said that, I keep a constant supply.
These are great! You cannot chew these so they last a long time. The flavors are great and keep your mouth moist.  Love them!
These are mostly pretty good and serve their purpose, but some of the flavors are too sour and dry my throat out even more.

reviews.t: Great product ,, and really good in shipping.
reviews.x: I am so thrilled to have found a dry mouth lozenge that works so very well.  Thank you.
I get dry mouth quite a bit from all my meds and they really help.
Really like the taste. Easy to have 4-5 of these in one setting.

These are the best dry mouth lozenges I've tried. They are a good size, individually wrapped, and surprisingly there ARE 10 flavors. I enjoy the rainbow of colors - green, blue, about three reds, orange, yellow, etc. The flavor is very good, not too strong and no menthol. These are exactly what I was looking for so I hope they continue to make them.  A great treatment for those of us with dry mouth.

Sent them bag. Tastes terrible. Also, I wanted to avoid a dry mouth but not at the expense of bad breath and weird color tongue. I tried all the flavors and they were gross. I think sugar free jolly ranchers have the same ingredients and taste way better and are cheaper. Apparently it’s the fake sugar/sugar alcohol that make them mouth moisturizing. Also really didn’t get that effect either

Don’t know if these work for normal ppls dry mouth- but I have a Disease called Sjogren’s, that makes my mouth and eyes excessively dry.  I did not feel like these added the moisture I needed. But then again none that I have tried has been satisfactory

reviews.t: Work very fast to fix dry mouth!
reviews.x: They work quickly to fix dry mouth, I’m so happy to have them always with me. You’ll like them too, they are worth buying. I get the 3 pack. They are assorted flavors, they aren’t delicious, but they all taste fruity and are fine.

reviews.t: Works very well for dey mouth!
reviews.x: These are a good product.  If you have dry mouth, these work great.  I would make the cellophane packets easier to open.  They are so hard to open often the lozenge goes flying onto the floor or to the bottom of my purse.
I live in Arizona. DRY DRY DRY and even dryer with air conditioners and fans running 24/7. These lozenges have been the only thing I have used that really help with dry mouth.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the lozenges effectively relieve dry mouth, including medication-induced, CPAP-related, and chronic cases.
Many reviewers praise the taste and flavor of the lozenges.
Reviewers frequently note that the lozenges are long-lasting compared to other products.
Several reviewers find the individual wrappers difficult to open, especially at night.
A few reviewers mention inconsistent or off-putting flavors, such as the grape flavor or dark-colored lozenges.
